    Secret forces every bound argument of a registered statement to be redacted
    as "[redacted]" even when LogConfig.Values is ValuesAllowed.

type StatementPolicy struct {
	Read, Write []string
	// RequireReturning requires an outer RETURNING clause for the Returning method.
	RequireReturning bool
	// AllowAuthorizedWriteCTE admits a signed modifying CTE with an outer read
	// result. The write list must include with and every native write command.
	// Direct SQL and unsigned calls retain the ordinary command policy.
	AllowAuthorizedWriteCTE bool
	// AllowAuthorizedWriteRoutine admits exact signed write routine calls under
	// Returning even though their SQL starts with SELECT. It grants no database
	// privilege and does not change read-only or session-escape checks.
	AllowAuthorizedWriteRoutine bool
}
    StatementPolicy lists the PostgreSQL commands accepted by session methods.
    Read applies to Scan and Each (select, table, values). Write applies to
    Exec and Returning (insert, update, delete, merge). Include with in the
    corresponding list to permit a WITH prefix on an otherwise allowed command.
    Command names are case-insensitive. With an active policy, an empty list
    permits no methods on that side. With no flags or command lists, both sides
    are unrestricted.

func (p StatementPolicy) Compile(singleStatement bool) (StatementGuard, error)
    Compile validates the allowlists and takes a copy of their contents.
    A configured policy implies singleStatement. With only singleStatement
    enabled, the guard checks statement boundaries without restricting the
    method.

type StatementShape struct {
	Inputs          []ShapeInput
	Result          []ShapeField
	Effects         ShapeEffects
	Privileges      []DefinedPrivilege
	Access          []ShapeAccess
	PhysicalColumns []ShapeColumn
	ForceRLS        []string
	SchemaUsage     []string
	AnyColumnSelect []string
	AnyColumnUpdate []string
	// Routines records the catalog contracts of called PostgreSQL functions.
	Routines []RoutineRequirement
	// Keys records the catalog primary-key premises of deterministic results.
	Keys []KeyRequirement `json:",omitempty"`
	// Comparisons records native ordering and deterministic collation premises.
	Comparisons []ComparisonRequirement `json:",omitempty"`
	// UniqueMatches proves at most one matching write-source row.
	UniqueMatches []UniqueMatchRequirement `json:",omitempty"`
	// Defaults records columns whose catalog defaults supply write values.
	Defaults []DefaultRequirement `json:",omitempty"`
	// Conflicts records premises checked against actual EXPLAIN arbiters.
	Conflicts []ConflictRequirement `json:",omitempty"`
	// ReturningRelations identifies physical targets with a RETURNING clause.
	ReturningRelations []string `json:",omitempty"`
	// ResultLineage supplies logical type evidence in Result order. An empty
	// entry supplies no additional evidence beyond the server description.
	ResultLineage []ResultLineage `json:",omitempty"`
	// UnscopedOnly marks a shape that omits a declared column-scope predicate.
	// It can be bound only to an unscoped session.
	UnscopedOnly bool
}
    StatementShape describes the inputs, results, effects and minimum grants for
    one SQL string in Definition.Statements under the same key.

type Table[T, K, S any] struct {
	descriptor[T, S]

	// Has unexported fields.
}
    Table is the compiled handle for a TableSpec. Its column bindings, SQL and
    access modes are fixed by Define.

func Define[T, K, S any](r *Registry[S], spec TableSpec[T, K]) *Table[T, K, S]
    Define validates spec, derives its fixed statements and column privileges,
    and records the table in r. Use DefinePlanSource for typed plans alone.

func DefinePlanSource[T, K, S any](r *Registry[S], spec TableSpec[T, K]) *Table[T, K, S]
    DefinePlanSource registers a physical table for typed plans. The source
    contributes its column and key metadata. Each plan declares its own SQL and
    privileges. Calls through Table.Bind return ErrOperationDenied. It panics on
    invalid declarations.

func (t *Table[T, K, S]) AllowsDelete() bool
    AllowsDelete reports whether the table permits physical deletes.

func (t *Table[T, K, S]) Bind(s Session[S]) *Rows[T, K, S]
    Bind binds the table's fixed and legacy operations to a session. A table
    registered with DefinePlanSource returns ErrOperationDenied from these
    operations. Bind its typed plans directly to the session.

func (t *Table[T, K, S]) Cols() string
    Cols is the select list, for hand-written statements scanned with
    Rows.Select.

func (t *Table[T, K, S]) DefineUpsert(key string, spec UpsertSpec, opts ...StatementOption) *UpsertPlan[T, K, S]
    DefineUpsert validates spec against t, registers its SQL statement under key
    in the Registry (so sqlcheck verifies it), and returns an executable plan.
    Panics on declaration errors at package initialization.

func (d *Table) Definition() Definition
    Definition returns a deep copy of the current registry entry.

func (t *Table[T, K, S]) Insert() string
    Insert is the INSERT base without RETURNING, for hand-written variants.
    WriteUpdateOnly has no INSERT base and returns an empty string.

func (t *Table[T, K, S]) InsertColumns() []string
    InsertColumns returns the columns bound from each input row for INSERT and
    COPY, in bind order.

func (d *Table) Name() string
    Name returns the name supplied at definition time.

func (t *Table[T, K, S]) ReadOnly() bool
    ReadOnly reports whether the declaration permits only reads.

func (t *Table[T, K, S]) Requires(table, privilege string, columns ...string) *Table[T, K, S]
    Requires registers an additional privilege required by this descriptor.

func (t *Table[T, K, S]) RequiresFunction(signature string) *Table[T, K, S]
    RequiresFunction registers an additional privilege required by this
    descriptor.

func (d *Table) Statement(key, query string, opts ...StatementOption) string
    Statement registers hand-written SQL for verification and observation.
    Keys are unique within a table or view.

func (t *Table[T, K, S]) TryDefineUpsert(key string, spec UpsertSpec, opts ...StatementOption) (*UpsertPlan[T, K, S], error)
    TryDefineUpsert validates spec and builds an UpsertPlan without recording it
    in the Registry.

type TableField[T, V any] struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    TableField identifies a typed column of one registered table across aliases.

func MappedColumn[V, T, S any](layout *TableLayout[T, S], name string) TableField[T, V]
    MappedColumn resolves a layout field once. V must match its declared value
    type. A pointer field mapped through its element is referenced with that
    element type and retains its SQL nullability.

func (f TableField[T, V]) Input(name string) Slot[V]
    Input creates a distinct input with the field's declared type, codec and
    secret flag, including when its expression is used on another relation.

func (f TableField[T, V]) On(rel Rel[T]) Field[V]
    On selects this column on an occurrence of the same registered table.

type TableLayout[T, S any] struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    TableLayout holds the column types and scan targets of one registered table.
    Multiple aliases share the immutable layout and have distinct occurrences.

func MapTable[T, K, S any](table *Table[T, K, S], overrides ...ColumnMapping) *TableLayout[T, S]
    MapTable declares a layout for a registered physical table. It panics on
    invalid declarations. Mapping or aliasing a table registers no statements.

func (layout *TableLayout[T, S]) As(alias string) RowSource[T, S]
    As creates a fresh occurrence using the table's declared scope and live-row
    policy. Reuse the returned source for fields, projections and joins.

type TableSelection struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    TableSelection is an ordered projection into a physical row struct.
    Construct it with SelectAll or SelectColumns.

func SelectAll() TableSelection
    SelectAll projects every physical column in descriptor order.

func SelectColumns(first RowColumn, rest ...RowColumn) TableSelection
    SelectColumns projects distinct columns of one occurrence in the supplied
    order. Each returned row has zero values for its unselected fields.

type TableSpec[T, K any] struct {
	// RelationScope declares how a typed query may access this physical table.
	// A tagged scope column implies ByScopeColumn when this field is zero.
	// An untagged table needs an explicit ByRLS or Global declaration for typed use.
	RelationScope RelationScope
	Name, Order   string
	Columns       []Column[T]
	SoftDelete    *SoftDelete
	// ReadOnly restricts this table to read operations only: no INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE
	// statements or write privileges are derived, and write methods return ErrReadOnly.
	ReadOnly bool
	// AllowDelete opts this table into physical DELETE statements (Delete / DeleteWhere)
	// and derives the table-level DELETE privilege for sqlcheck. Cannot combine with ReadOnly.
	AllowDelete bool
	// GroupBy whitelists declared columns for CountBy aggregates and records
	// per-column count_by_<col> statements in Definition for sqlcheck verification.
	GroupBy []string
	// Aggregates registers scalar function/column pairs for sqlcheck verification.
	Aggregates ScalarAggregates
	// WriteMode restricts derived SQL, privileges and bound operations. An explicit
	// mode excludes ReadOnly and AllowDelete and rejects hand-written SQL on Rows.
	WriteMode WriteMode
	// UpdateColumns limits WriteUpdateOnly to these columns, in descriptor order.
	// Nil selects every updatable column. A version column must be included.
	UpdateColumns []string
}
    TableSpec declares one table of rows T keyed by K: the qualified name,
    the default order of List, optional SoftDelete config, and the row type's
    db tags, read once by Define. Tag options: key, serial, scope, deleted,
    version, once, json, zero, array, secret.

type TraceInfo struct {
	Key    string
	Table  string
	Action string
	Scope  string
	Role   string
	// RawErrorDiagnostics permits the tracer to record the original error text.
	RawErrorDiagnostics bool
}
    TraceInfo identifies one statement execution for Tracer and Metrics hooks.
    Statement keys double as span names and metric labels.

type Tracer interface {
	Start(ctx context.Context, info TraceInfo) (context.Context, func(rows int64, err error))
}
    Tracer starts and ends a span around each statement execution. Passed
    explicitly via RegistryConfig.Tracer or RunnerOptions.Tracer; nil disables
    tracing. Finish receives a diagnostic with the error class and SQLSTATE by
    default. With RawErrorDiagnostics enabled it receives the original error.

type TypeDefault struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    TypeDefault declares a registry's exact PostgreSQL type for a Go value type.
    Construct it with TypeMapping.

func TypeMapping[V any](kind PGType[V]) TypeDefault
    TypeMapping retains the catalog identity and input codec of kind as a
    registry default for V. A nullable *V field can use the same declaration.

type TypeFamily struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    TypeFamily pairs a Go value type with the PostgreSQL catalog type names
    considered compatible during DefineSQL, DefineSQLExec, DefineSQLReturning
    and DefineSQLList verification. Construct it with TypeFamilyOf.

func TypeFamilyOf[T any](pgTypes ...string) TypeFamily
    TypeFamilyOf declares the PostgreSQL type names compatible with Go type T
    (for example "uuid", "numeric", or "public.item_status"). Pointer fields *T
    automatically inherit T's family unless overridden separately.

type UniqueMatchRequirement struct {
	Relation string
	Columns  []string
}
    UniqueMatchRequirement records a physical write-source uniqueness premise.
    Columns must contain a complete immediate, valid unique index key whose
    columns are NOT NULL. A table name or an application assertion is not
    evidence of uniqueness.

type UnnestInput interface {
	// Has unexported methods.
}
    UnnestInput is a sealed array-column or ordinality declaration.

type UpdateStatement struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    UpdateStatement declares an UPDATE with explicit assignments and matching.

func UpdateOf[T, S any](src RowSource[T, S]) UpdateStatement
    UpdateOf starts a typed update. Where or AllRows is required.

func (q UpdateStatement) AllRows() UpdateStatement
    AllRows explicitly permits updating every authorized live row.

func (q UpdateStatement) From(source ReadSource, on Pred) UpdateStatement
    From adds an explicitly matched UPDATE source. Value-bearing matches require
    an immediate non-null unique catalog key or a proven relational result key.

func (q UpdateStatement) Set(first RowAssignment, rest ...RowAssignment) UpdateStatement
    Set declares the complete ordered UPDATE assignment list. Expressions
    read the old row. Protected keys, once, scope and version fields cannot be
    assigned.

func (q UpdateStatement) UnscopedOnly() UpdateStatement
    UnscopedOnly declares an update without column-scope predicates.

func (q UpdateStatement) Version(version RowVersion) UpdateStatement
    Version adds the descriptor's optimistic version check and automatic
    increment.

func (q UpdateStatement) Where(first Pred, rest ...Pred) UpdateStatement
    Where appends fixed predicates to the UPDATE.

func (q UpdateStatement) With(tables ...CommonTable) UpdateStatement
    With attaches common tables to the outer UPDATE.

type UpsertPlan[T, K, S any] struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    UpsertPlan is a validated, registered upsert statement bound to one Table.

func (u *UpsertPlan[T, K, S]) Key() string
    Key returns the registered statement key.

func (u *UpsertPlan[T, K, S]) SQL() string
    SQL returns the derived INSERT ... ON CONFLICT statement.

type UpsertSpec struct {
	Conflict  []string
	Update    []string
	Where     string
	Returning []string
}
    UpsertSpec declares a controlled PostgreSQL INSERT ... ON CONFLICT
    statement. Conflict columns identify the unique index or constraint target.
    Update lists the columns updated on conflict (key, scope, and once columns
    are forbidden); leaving Update empty produces ON CONFLICT (...) DO NOTHING.
    WriteInsertOnly accepts an empty spec for targetless ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING.
    An explicit conflict target or RETURNING list would require SELECT on its
    columns.

type ValueSelect[V any] struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    ValueSelect is a one-column query with an implicit exported identity.
    It is composed without creating a View or registering an executable plan.

func SelectValue[V any](value Expr[V]) ValueSelect[V]
    SelectValue starts a scalar-result query.

func (q ValueSelect[V]) CrossJoin(source ReadSource) ValueSelect[V]
    CrossJoin declares a product.

func (q ValueSelect[V]) CrossLateral(source QuerySource) ValueSelect[V]
    CrossLateral declares an explicit lateral product.

func (q ValueSelect[V]) Distinct() ValueSelect[V]
    Distinct removes duplicate values.

func (q ValueSelect[V]) From(source ReadSource) ValueSelect[V]
    From declares the first query occurrence.

func (q ValueSelect[V]) GroupBy(fields ...GroupField) ValueSelect[V]
    GroupBy declares grouping expressions.

func (q ValueSelect[V]) Having(terms ...Pred) ValueSelect[V]
    Having filters aggregate groups.

func (q ValueSelect[V]) InnerJoin(source ReadSource, on Pred) ValueSelect[V]
    InnerJoin declares an explicit matching occurrence.

func (q ValueSelect[V]) InnerLateral(source QuerySource, on Pred) ValueSelect[V]
    InnerLateral joins a query using explicitly declared preceding references.

func (q ValueSelect[V]) LeftJoin(source ReadSource, on Pred) ValueSelect[V]
    LeftJoin preserves unmatched left rows.

func (q ValueSelect[V]) LeftLateral(source QuerySource, on Pred) ValueSelect[V]
    LeftLateral preserves left rows when the lateral result is empty.

func (q ValueSelect[V]) Limit(input Slot[int64], ceiling int64) ValueSelect[V]
    Limit applies a caller-bound limit with a finite ceiling checked before I/O.

func (q ValueSelect[V]) OrderBy(terms ...RowTerm) ValueSelect[V]
    OrderBy declares result ordering.

func (q ValueSelect[V]) Take(n int64) ValueSelect[V]
    Take applies a nonnegative fixed bound through a private parameter.

func (q ValueSelect[V]) Where(terms ...Pred) ValueSelect[V]
    Where filters input rows.

func (q ValueSelect[V]) With(tables ...CommonTable) ValueSelect[V]
    With attaches common-table declarations.

type View[T, S any] struct {
	descriptor[T, S]
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    View is the compiled row shape for a hand-written query.

func DefineView[T, S any](r *Registry[S], spec ViewSpec[T]) *View[T, S]
    DefineView validates v against r (panicking on declaration mistakes at
    package initialization) and records it in r.DefinedViews().

func (v *View[T, S]) Bind(s Session[S]) *ViewRows[T, S]
    Bind binds this projection to the scope of s.

func (v *View[T, S]) Cols() string
    Cols returns the comma-separated select column list in struct field order.

func (v *View[T, S]) ColsAs(alias string) string
    ColsAs returns the select column list qualified with table alias (e.g.
    "c.id, c.name").

func (v *View[T, S]) DefineQuery(key string, spec QuerySpec, opts ...StatementOption) *Query[T, S]
    DefineQuery validates spec against v, registers C3 verification variants
    in v's ViewDefinition.Statements, and returns a compiled Query handle.
    Panics on declaration mistakes at package initialization.

func (v *View[T, S]) Definition() ViewDefinition
    Definition returns a deep copy of the registered view metadata.

func (d *View) Name() string
    Name returns the name supplied at definition time.

func (v *View[T, S]) Requires(table, privilege string, columns ...string) *View[T, S]
    Requires registers an additional privilege required by this descriptor.

func (v *View[T, S]) RequiresFunction(signature string) *View[T, S]
    RequiresFunction registers an additional privilege required by this
    descriptor.

func (v *View[T, S]) SelectAs(aliases map[string]string) string
    SelectAs generates a JOIN SELECT list from prefix-to-table-alias mappings
    (e.g. aliases{"o_": "o", "c_": "c"} produces "o.id AS o_id, ..., c.id AS
    c_id"). Columns whose prefix is not in aliases are emitted as their plain
    name.

func (d *View) Statement(key, query string, opts ...StatementOption) string
    Statement registers hand-written SQL for verification and observation.
    Keys are unique within a table or view.

func (v *View[T, S]) TryDefineQuery(key string, spec QuerySpec, opts ...StatementOption) (*Query[T, S], error)
    TryDefineQuery validates and compiles spec against v without registering C3
    variants in the registry.

type ViewDefinition Definition
    ViewDefinition describes a registered query projection.

type ViewRows[T, S any] struct{ readBinding[T, S] }
    ViewRows decodes hand-written SQL using the bound projection.

func (r *ViewRows[T, S]) Iter(ctx context.Context, query string, args ...any) iter.Seq2[T, error]
    Iter decodes rows as they arrive. Breaking the range releases the cursor.

func (r *ViewRows[T, S]) One(ctx context.Context, query string, args ...any) (*T, error)
    One reads at most one row. A missing row returns nil, nil.

func (r *ViewRows[T, S]) Scan(ctx context.Context, query string, args []any, dest ...any) error
    Scan executes a scalar single-row query with the registry error policy.

func (r *ViewRows[T, S]) Select(ctx context.Context, query string, args ...any) ([]T, error)
    Select decodes all rows of query.

func (r *ViewRows[T, S]) WithLogger(logger *slog.Logger) *ViewRows[T, S]
    WithLogger returns a handle with a per-binding logger override.

type ViewSpec[T any] struct {
	Name    string
	Columns []Column[T]
}
    ViewSpec declares a read-only row projection T (such as a JOIN result,
    summary, or auxiliary lookup table) without requiring a key, scope, deleted,
    or version column. It reuses the Registry's db-tag codecs (UUID, JSON, Zero,
    Array, custom Scanner/Valuer) and supports nested struct column prefixes
    (e.g. `Job JobRow` tagged `db:"j_"` maps j_id, j_code, ...).

type WindowFrame struct {
	Mode    FrameMode
	Start   FrameBound
	End     FrameBound
	Exclude FrameExclusion
}
    WindowFrame declares an explicit BETWEEN frame. A zero value preserves the
    PostgreSQL default. Dynamic negative or NULL offsets retain PostgreSQL's
    native error; offsets never interpolate a value into SQL. ROWS/GROUPS use an
    exact int8 expression; RANGE uses a reviewed native ordering/offset pair.

func RunningRows() WindowFrame
    RunningRows includes the partition's rows through the current ordered row.

func WholePartition() WindowFrame
    WholePartition explicitly includes every row of the partition.

type WindowSpec struct {
	Name      string
	Partition []Scalar
	Order     []RowTerm
	Frame     WindowFrame
}
    WindowSpec declares partitioning, peer order and an optional frame. A zero
    Frame retains PostgreSQL's default RANGE frame. Name optionally shares this
    complete specification within the SELECT; repeated names must agree exactly.

type WriteMode uint8
    WriteMode selects the operations a table derives and accepts on bound Rows.
    A PostgreSQL role enforces access for SQL issued through other handles.

const (
	// WriteDefault uses TableSpec.ReadOnly and TableSpec.AllowDelete.
	WriteDefault WriteMode = iota
	// WriteUpdateOnly permits derived reads, locks and updates.
	WriteUpdateOnly
	// WriteInsertOnly permits inserts, COPY and targetless ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING.
	// Inserts leave a generated serial key in PostgreSQL and never read it back.
	WriteInsertOnly
)
type WritePlan[S any] struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    WritePlan is a registered count-only write. Binding never changes its SQL.

func DefineWrite[T, S any](owner RowSource[T, S], name string, query WriteStatement, observe ...StatementOption) *WritePlan[S]
    DefineWrite registers a write owned by its outer physical target. It panics
    on declaration errors; the Try partner publishes nothing on failure.

func (p *WritePlan[S]) Bind(session Session[S]) *BoundWritePlan[S]
    Bind attaches the write to a session from the declaring registry.

type WriteStatement interface {
	// Has unexported methods.
}
    WriteStatement is a sealed declaration of a mutation. It does not execute
    SQL. A write plan checks its physical targets and registers all permitted
    forms.

type ZeroValue[V any] struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    ZeroValue holds a nullable column as a plain Go value: NULL reads as the
    zero value and the value is bound as itself.

func (v *ZeroValue[V]) Scan(src any) error

func (v *ZeroValue[V]) Value() (driver.Value, error)

## oteltabula

```text
package oteltabula // import "github.com/0xJean/tabula/oteltabula"

Package oteltabula bridges tabula.Tracer and tabula.Metrics to the OpenTelemetry
Go API (go.opentelemetry.io/otel). It lives in its own Go module so core tabula
packages keep their zero-third-party-dependency boundary.

CONSTANTS

const InstrumentationName = "github.com/0xJean/tabula/oteltabula"
    InstrumentationName is the default OpenTelemetry instrumentation scope name.


FUNCTIONS

func NewMetrics(mp metric.MeterProvider, opts ...Option) (tabula.Metrics, error)
    NewMetrics returns a tabula.Metrics backed by mp (defaulting to
    otel.GetMeterProvider when mp is nil). It records tabula.statement.duration
    (seconds) and tabula.statement.count ({statement}) with bounded-cardinality
    attributes (db.system, tabula.table, tabula.action, tabula.role,
    tabula.error_class, plus any static WithAttributes). Per-tenant scope and
    inline statement keys are emitted on trace spans only.

func NewTracer(tp trace.TracerProvider, opts ...Option) tabula.Tracer
    NewTracer returns a tabula.Tracer backed by tp (defaulting to
    otel.GetTracerProvider when tp is nil). Attach it to RunnerOptions.Tracer
    or RegistryConfig.Tracer. Failures record the error class and SQLSTATE.
    With RawErrorDiagnostics enabled, exception messages and status descriptions
    also contain the original error text, which may include bound values.


TYPES

type Option func(*config)
    Option customizes a Tracer or Metrics adapter created by this package.

func WithAttributes(attrs ...attribute.KeyValue) Option
    WithAttributes appends static attributes (for example db.namespace or
    server.address) to every emitted span and metric observation.

func WithInstrumentationName(name string) Option
    WithInstrumentationName overrides the OpenTelemetry scope name.

func WithInstrumentationVersion(version string) Option
    WithInstrumentationVersion attaches an instrumentation scope version.

```

## pgtype

```text
package pgtype // import "github.com/0xJean/tabula/pgtype"

Package pgtype declares PostgreSQL catalog types for typed Tabula fields,
expressions and parameters. Each constructor returns a tabula.PGType.

FUNCTIONS

func ArrayOf[V any](element tabula.PGType[V]) tabula.PGType[[]V]
    ArrayOf declares a one-dimensional PostgreSQL array of the given element
    type. Its driver array adapter handles the elements.

func ArrayOfNullable[V any](element tabula.PGType[V]) tabula.PGType[[]*V]
    ArrayOfNullable declares a one-dimensional array of nullable scalar values.
    A nil element round-trips independently of an empty or SQL NULL array.

func BPChar() tabula.PGType[string]
    BPChar declares PostgreSQL's blank-padded character catalog type.

func Bool() tabula.PGType[bool]
    Bool declares a PostgreSQL boolean.

func Bytea() tabula.PGType[[]byte]
    Bytea declares a PostgreSQL byte string. A nil slice binds SQL NULL and a
    non-nil empty slice binds an empty byte string.

func CIDR() tabula.PGType[netip.Prefix]
    CIDR declares a PostgreSQL cidr network. PostgreSQL requires zero host bits.
    An invalid prefix binds SQL NULL.

func Date() tabula.PGType[time.Time]
    Date declares a PostgreSQL date using the year, month and day in the Go
    value's location.

func Float4() tabula.PGType[float32]
    Float4 declares a PostgreSQL real.

func Float8() tabula.PGType[float64]
    Float8 declares a PostgreSQL double precision value.

func Inet() tabula.PGType[netip.Addr]
    Inet declares an inet host address. An invalid address binds SQL NULL.

func InetPrefix() tabula.PGType[netip.Prefix]
    InetPrefix declares an inet address with its network prefix length.
    An invalid prefix binds SQL NULL.

func Int2() tabula.PGType[int16]
    Int2 declares a PostgreSQL smallint.

func Int4() tabula.PGType[int32]
    Int4 declares a PostgreSQL integer.

func Int8() tabula.PGType[int64]
    Int8 declares a PostgreSQL bigint.

func Interval() tabula.PGType[string]
    Interval declares a PostgreSQL interval using text. The value can contain
    calendar months, days and fractional seconds.

func JSON[V any]() tabula.PGType[V]
    JSON declares a PostgreSQL json value. Bindings marshal structured values
    and strings using encoding/json. A json.RawMessage is a serialized document.
    Nil pointers, maps, slices and interfaces bind SQL NULL. A raw document
    containing null binds JSON null.

func JSONB[V any]() tabula.PGType[V]
    JSONB declares a PostgreSQL jsonb value with the same input rules as JSON.

func Numeric[V any]() tabula.PGType[V]
    Numeric declares a PostgreSQL numeric. Numeric[string] binds decimal text
    with its original precision and scale. Driver values and custom encoders can
    supply other exact representations.

func OID() tabula.PGType[uint32]
    OID declares a PostgreSQL object identifier.

func Text() tabula.PGType[string]
    Text declares PostgreSQL text.

func Time() tabula.PGType[string]
    Time declares PostgreSQL time without time zone using time-of-day text.

func Timestamp() tabula.PGType[time.Time]
    Timestamp declares a PostgreSQL timestamp without time zone using the civil
    date and clock fields in the Go value's location.

func Timestamptz() tabula.PGType[time.Time]
    Timestamptz declares a PostgreSQL timestamp with time zone for an instant.

func Timetz() tabula.PGType[string]
    Timetz declares PostgreSQL time with time zone using time-of-day text with
    an explicit UTC offset.

func UUID[V any]() tabula.PGType[V]
    UUID declares a PostgreSQL uuid. Use UUID[string] for UUID text or supply a
    Go representation supported by the driver or a custom input encoder.

func Varchar(length ...int) tabula.PGType[string]
    Varchar declares PostgreSQL character varying. Supply one length to verify
    the column's character limit. A parameter always uses base varchar.

```

## pgxdriver

```text
package pgxdriver // import "github.com/0xJean/tabula/pgxdriver"

Package pgxdriver integrates github.com/jackc/pgx/v5 with tabula: PostgreSQL
array column converters, role-bound transaction Runners, guarded Sessions,
savepoints, binary COPY, and read-only Direct pools.

FUNCTIONS

func ArrayColumn(ft reflect.Type) (func(any) any, error)
    ArrayColumn selects pgx's native one-dimensional array codec. Its type
    map handles built-in and named Go slices, including pointer elements that
    distinguish a SQL NULL from the scalar's zero value.

func CopyFrom[T, K, S any](ctx context.Context, sess *Session[S], tbl *tabula.Table[T, K, S], rows []T) (int64, error)
    CopyFrom bulk-inserts rows into tbl using PostgreSQL's binary COPY protocol
    via pgx.Tx.CopyFrom. It checks session provenance (A4), permission to
    insert, DenyCopy and DenyUnscopedWrites (A6), and closed-session state
    before any empty-input shortcut or driver access, then checks each row's
    scope via CheckWrite.

    An empty rows slice returns 0, nil after passing capability and session
    checks without touching the database.

func SQLVerifier(pool *pgxpool.Pool) sqlcheck.Verifier
    SQLVerifier supplies non-executing PostgreSQL statement descriptions to
    sqlcheck. It may be used independently of the application's runtime driver.
    Each verification uses one read-only transaction and always rolls it back.

func SetLocalConfig(ctx context.Context, tx pgx.Tx, key, value string) error
    SetLocalConfig sets a PostgreSQL transaction-local GUC via set_config(...,
    true).

func SetLocalRole(ctx context.Context, tx pgx.Tx, role string) error
    SetLocalRole switches the PostgreSQL role for the duration of tx.


TYPES

type DirectConfig struct {
	// SQLAuthority accepts calls issued by one registry. A strict credential
	// also rejects direct SQL text on sessions of this pool.
	SQLAuthority tabula.SQLAuthority
	SessionKey   tabula.SessionKey
	Observer     *tabula.Observer
}
    DirectConfig configures A4 session signing and B1/B3 observability on a
    read-only DirectPool created by DirectWithConfig.

type DirectOption func(*pgxpool.Config)
    DirectOption customizes the pgxpool.Config used by Direct or
    DirectWithConfig before the pool is created. Direct always enforces
    default_transaction_read_only=on after applying options.

type DirectPool[S any] struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    DirectPool owns a pool of read-only pgx connections.

func Direct[S any](ctx context.Context, dsn string, policy ScopePolicy[S], opts ...DirectOption) (*DirectPool[S], error)
    Direct opens a dedicated pool with read-only mode in the startup parameters
    of every physical connection. Session binds each request without SQL.
    Managed transaction-local variables require a Runner. Call Close at
    shutdown.

func DirectWithConfig[S any](ctx context.Context, dsn string, policy ScopePolicy[S], dcfg DirectConfig, opts ...DirectOption) (*DirectPool[S], error)
    DirectWithConfig is Direct with A4 SessionKey signing and optional B1/B3
    session observability while preserving native DirectOption hooks and
    default_transaction_read_only=on.

func (p *DirectPool[S]) Close() error
    Close releases the underlying connection pool.

func (p *DirectPool[S]) Session(scope S) tabula.Session[S]
    Session binds the scope without opening a transaction or checking out a
    connection.

func (p *DirectPool[S]) Stat() *pgxpool.Stat
    Stat returns the current pgxpool statistics.

type RawSession[S any] struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    RawSession wraps a *Session[S] with explicit raw pgx.Tx escape access. It is
    constructed only when RunnerOptions.ExposeTx is true via Runner.WithinRaw.

func (s *RawSession[S]) Each(ctx context.Context, query string, args []any, decode func(func(...any) error) error) error
    Each streams all rows of query through decode.

func (s *RawSession[S]) EachAuthorized(ctx context.Context, call tabula.AuthorizedStatement, visit func(func(...any) error) error) error
    EachAuthorized verifies a registered streaming call for this instance.

func (s *RawSession[S]) Exec(ctx context.Context, query string, args ...any) (int64, error)
    Exec executes query and returns the affected row count.

func (s *RawSession[S]) ExecAuthorized(ctx context.Context, call tabula.AuthorizedStatement) (int64, error)
    ExecAuthorized verifies a registered mutation for this raw-session instance.

func (s *RawSession[S]) ReadOnly() bool
    ReadOnly reports whether this handle permits only reads.

func (s *RawSession[S]) Returning(ctx context.Context, query string, args []any, dest ...any) error
    Returning executes a write with RETURNING and maps pgx.ErrNoRows to
    sql.ErrNoRows.

func (s *RawSession[S]) SQLAuthority() tabula.SQLAuthority
    SQLAuthority returns the credential of the underlying session.

func (s *RawSession[S]) Savepoint(ctx context.Context, fn func(context.Context, *Session[S]) error) error
    Savepoint runs fn inside a nested pgx transaction (PostgreSQL SAVEPOINT).

func (s *RawSession[S]) Scan(ctx context.Context, query string, args []any, dest ...any) error
    Scan executes a single-row query and maps pgx.ErrNoRows to sql.ErrNoRows.

func (s *RawSession[S]) ScanAuthorized(ctx context.Context, call tabula.AuthorizedStatement, dest ...any) error
    ScanAuthorized verifies a registered single-row call for this instance.

func (s *RawSession[S]) Scope() S
    Scope returns the session's bound scope value.

func (s *RawSession[S]) Session() *Session[S]
    Session returns the underlying guarded *Session[S].

func (s *RawSession[S]) SessionProof() tabula.SessionProof
    SessionProof returns the instance-bound proof for this *RawSession[S].

func (s *RawSession[S]) TabulaObserved() tabula.ObserveMask
    TabulaObserved reports which observability signals this session owns.

func (s *RawSession[S]) Tx() pgx.Tx
    Tx returns the underlying pgx.Tx. Only available on *RawSession[S].

func (s *RawSession[S]) Unscoped() bool
    Unscoped reports whether this session bypasses row-level scope predicates.

func (s *RawSession[S]) WithinOperation(ctx context.Context, fn func(context.Context, tabula.Session[S]) error) error
    WithinOperation delegates to the guarded transaction handle. The operation
    callback receives a guarded child without a raw transaction escape.

type RunOptions[S any] struct {
	TxOptions    pgx.TxOptions
	BeforeCommit func(context.Context, *Session[S]) error
}
    RunOptions customizes a single runner transaction invocation, including an
    optional BeforeCommit step executed on a fresh handle after the body handle
    closes.

type Runner[S any] struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    Runner opens role-bound, guarded PostgreSQL transactions on a *pgxpool.Pool.

func NewRunner[S any](pool *pgxpool.Pool, policy ScopePolicy[S], opts RunnerOptions) (*Runner[S], error)
    NewRunner validates policy and opts and creates a guarded Runner backed by
    pool.

func (r *Runner[S]) Within(ctx context.Context, scope S, fn func(context.Context, *Session[S]) error) error
    Within runs fn in a read-write transaction. On a ReadOnly runner, Within
    fails closed with tabula.ErrReadOnly before BEGIN. A top-level commit error
    matches tabula.ErrCommit and wraps its driver cause.

func (r *Runner[S]) WithinRaw(ctx context.Context, scope S, fn func(context.Context, *RawSession[S]) error) error
    WithinRaw runs fn with a *RawSession[S] exposing Tx() pgx.Tx. Requires
    RunnerOptions.ExposeTx == true; otherwise returns tabula.ErrCapabilityDenied
    before BEGIN.

func (r *Runner[S]) WithinRawTxOptions(ctx context.Context, scope S, opts pgx.TxOptions, fn func(context.Context, *RawSession[S]) error) error
    WithinRawTxOptions runs fn with a *RawSession[S] under explicit
    pgx.TxOptions.

func (r *Runner[S]) WithinReadOnly(ctx context.Context, scope S, fn func(context.Context, *Session[S]) error) error
    WithinReadOnly runs fn in a READ ONLY transaction. The runner establishes
    the first PostgreSQL snapshot before calling fn, even with an empty policy.

func (r *Runner[S]) WithinRetry(ctx context.Context, scope S, cfg tabula.RetryConfig, fn func(context.Context, *Session[S]) error) error
    WithinRetry runs the full transaction attempt up to cfg.MaxAttempts times
    via tabula.Retry whenever the attempt fails with a retryable error.
    The callback must be idempotent apart from database writes.

func (r *Runner[S]) WithinRetryWith(ctx context.Context, scope S, cfg tabula.RetryConfig, runOpts RunOptions[S], fn func(context.Context, *Session[S]) error) error
    WithinRetryWith is WithinRetry with explicit RunOptions (isolation,
    read-only, BeforeCommit). Each retry that completes fn runs BeforeCommit
    once.

func (r *Runner[S]) WithinShared(ctx context.Context, fn func(context.Context, *Shared[S]) error) error
    WithinShared opens one transaction that can switch between scoped and
    unscoped handles via Shared.Scoped and Shared.Unscoped.

func (r *Runner[S]) WithinSharedOptions(ctx context.Context, opts pgx.TxOptions, fn func(context.Context, *Shared[S]) error) error
    WithinSharedOptions is WithinShared with explicit pgx.TxOptions. With
    UnscopedReadRole configured, the runner restores Role before COMMIT.

func (r *Runner[S]) WithinTxOptions(ctx context.Context, scope S, opts pgx.TxOptions, fn func(context.Context, *Session[S]) error) error
    WithinTxOptions runs fn inside a transaction opened with opts.

func (r *Runner[S]) WithinWith(ctx context.Context, scope S, runOpts RunOptions[S], fn func(context.Context, *Session[S]) error) error
    WithinWith runs fn inside a transaction configured with runOpts, including
    an optional BeforeCommit step executed on a fresh handle before COMMIT.

type RunnerOptions struct {
	// RequireCallbackContext restricts live sessions to the runner callback's
	// context and its descendants. The default accepts any context.
	RequireCallbackContext bool
	// SingleStatement restricts session SQL to one data statement before driver I/O.
	SingleStatement bool
	// Statements restricts commands by method and implies SingleStatement when configured.
	Statements  tabula.StatementPolicy
	Role        string
	RequireRole bool
	ReadOnly    bool
	Unscoped    UnscopedMode
	// UnscopedReadRole enables read-only unscoped handles within WithinShared.
	// Requires UnscopedReadOnly and a distinct scoped Role. Migrations must grant
	// this role read access only, including through functions and inherited grants.
	// An empty value keeps unscoped access restricted to READ ONLY transactions.
	UnscopedReadRole string
	Timeouts         Timeouts
	// SQLAuthority verifies descriptor calls from one registry. Its DenyLegacySQL
	// policy also disables raw session methods and raw transaction access.
	SQLAuthority tabula.SQLAuthority
	SessionKey   tabula.SessionKey
	ExposeTx     bool
	Tracer       tabula.Tracer
	Metrics      tabula.Metrics
	Log          tabula.LogConfig
	// RawErrorDiagnostics passes original errors to the statement tracer. Driver
	// messages can contain bound values. The default traces the class and SQLSTATE.
	RawErrorDiagnostics bool
	// Sanitize supplies reviewed log text for errors. The default is the error class.
	Sanitize      func(error) string
	TagStatements bool
}
    RunnerOptions configures a role-bound, guarded pgxdriver.Runner.

type ScopePolicy[S any] struct {
	ManagedVars  []string
	ScopeVars    func(S) map[string]string
	ContextVars  func(context.Context) map[string]string
	IsUnscoped   func(S) bool
	UnscopedVars map[string]string
	InactiveVars map[string]string
	GuardQuery   func(query string) error
	ScopeLog     func(S) string
}
    ScopePolicy configures transaction-local scope variables, context-derived
    variables, unscoped mode detection and SQL guards for a pgx Runner.

func NoScopePolicy() ScopePolicy[struct{}]
    NoScopePolicy returns an empty ScopePolicy for applications without
    row-level scoping.

type Session[S any] struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    Session implements tabula.Session[S] over one pgx.Tx without exposing
    the raw transaction. Overlapping statements or savepoint requests on the
    transaction return tabula.ErrSessionBusy, including inside Each or a binary
    COPY.

func NewSession[S any](tx pgx.Tx, scope S, policy ScopePolicy[S]) *Session[S]
    NewSession wraps an existing pgx.Tx with scope and policy as an unsealed
    migration handle. Keyed registries require a Runner or keyed DirectPool.

func (s *Session[S]) Each(ctx context.Context, query string, args []any, visit func(func(...any) error) error) error
    Each streams rows on a runner that allows SQL text. The runner closes an
    unfinished cursor at transaction or savepoint exit.

func (s *Session[S]) EachAuthorized(ctx context.Context, call tabula.AuthorizedStatement, visit func(func(...any) error) error) error
    EachAuthorized streams a registered read or multirow write. A returning
    write uses the write policy and holds the cursor until iteration ends.

func (s *Session[S]) Exec(ctx context.Context, query string, args ...any) (int64, error)
    Exec executes SQL text on a runner that allows it.

func (s *Session[S]) ExecAuthorized(ctx context.Context, call tabula.AuthorizedStatement) (int64, error)
    ExecAuthorized executes a registered mutation and returns its affected-row
    count.

func (s *Session[S]) ReadOnly() bool
    ReadOnly reports whether this handle permits only reads.

func (s *Session[S]) Returning(ctx context.Context, query string, args []any, dest ...any) error
    Returning reads one row from a write on a runner that allows SQL text.

func (s *Session[S]) SQLAuthority() tabula.SQLAuthority
    SQLAuthority returns the registry credential configured on the runner.

func (s *Session[S]) Savepoint(ctx context.Context, fn func(context.Context, *Session[S]) error) (err error)
    Savepoint runs fn inside a nested pgx transaction (PostgreSQL SAVEPOINT).
    The child *Session[S] receives a fresh instance-bound SessionProof and is
    closed when Savepoint returns.

func (s *Session[S]) Scan(ctx context.Context, query string, args []any, dest ...any) error
    Scan reads a single row on a runner that allows SQL text.

func (s *Session[S]) ScanAuthorized(ctx context.Context, call tabula.AuthorizedStatement, dest ...any) error
    ScanAuthorized decodes one result of a registered read or write. A write
    follows the runner's Returning policy.

func (s *Session[S]) Scope() S
    Scope returns the session's bound scope value.

func (s *Session[S]) SessionProof() tabula.SessionProof
    SessionProof returns the instance-bound proof for A4 sealed registries.

func (s *Session[S]) TabulaObserved() tabula.ObserveMask
    TabulaObserved reports which observability signals this session owns.

func (s *Session[S]) Unscoped() bool
    Unscoped reports whether this session bypasses row-level scope predicates.

func (s *Session[S]) WithinOperation(ctx context.Context, fn func(context.Context, tabula.Session[S]) error) (err error)
    WithinOperation runs fn in an operation savepoint. Its sealed child is
    the only usable handle until fn returns. Errors and panics roll back the
    operation; cleanup failure or cancellation discovered after a successful
    callback prevents the enclosing runner from committing.

type Shared[S any] struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    Shared exposes scoped and unscoped Session handles sharing a single pgx
    transaction. Before every user statement on a child handle, the complete
    managed GUC state is reapplied in one batch. With UnscopedReadRole the
    runner also selects the handle's database role before each statement.

func (s *Shared[S]) Scoped(scope S) *Session[S]
    Scoped returns a scoped Session handle sharing this transaction.

func (s *Shared[S]) Unscoped() *Session[S]
    Unscoped returns an unscoped Session handle sharing this transaction.
    UnscopedReadOnly requires a READ ONLY transaction unless UnscopedReadRole is
    configured. That role permits Scan and Each while scoped handles use Role.
    UnscopedDenied rejects all operations with tabula.ErrCapabilityDenied.

type Timeouts struct {
	Lock              time.Duration
	Statement         time.Duration
	IdleInTransaction time.Duration
	Transaction       time.Duration
}
    Timeouts configures per-runner PostgreSQL transaction-local timeouts and an
    optional Go context deadline covering the entire attempt.

type UnscopedMode uint8
    UnscopedMode controls whether a Runner permits unscoped sessions.

const (
	// UnscopedDenied rejects every unscoped transaction before BEGIN (default).
	UnscopedDenied UnscopedMode = iota
	// UnscopedReadOnly permits unscoped reads in READ ONLY transactions or via
	// an explicitly configured UnscopedReadRole in WithinShared.
	UnscopedReadOnly
	// UnscopedReadWrite permits unscoped sessions in read-only and read-write transactions.
	UnscopedReadWrite
)
```

## postgresfixture

```text
package postgresfixture // import "github.com/0xJean/tabula/postgresfixture"

Package postgresfixture caches installed PostgreSQL test databases by content
and gives each test a fresh clone. The application supplies installation and
database lifecycle operations on its disposable PostgreSQL server.

TYPES

type Backend interface {
	Clone(ctx context.Context, admin *sql.Conn, source, target string) error
	Install(ctx context.Context, target string, plan Installation) error
	Drop(ctx context.Context, admin *sql.Conn, target string) error
}
    Backend is supplied by the test suite. Clone and Drop use the supplied
    maintenance connection in autocommit. Install must disconnect from its
    target before returning so PostgreSQL can clone the installed database.
    Fixture.Prune also calls Drop for cached templates and abandoned staging
    databases, so Drop must accept a template (clearing IS_TEMPLATE if Clone set
    it) and may release host resources tied to it.

type Database struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    Database is an isolated per-test clone.

func (d Database) Drop(ctx context.Context) error
    Drop removes this clone through its host backend.

func (d Database) Name() string
    Name is the database name to use in the test connection string.

type Fixture struct {
	Admin   *sql.DB
	Backend Backend
}
    Fixture uses an explicit maintenance database and host-defined backend.

func (f Fixture) AcquireLoginRole(ctx context.Context, opts LoginRoleOptions) (*LoginRole, error)
    AcquireLoginRole creates a fresh process login. Supply a direct or
    session-pooled connection to the same maintenance database used by Prune.
    The host grants CONNECT to the login when preparing each test database.
    Losing the pinned server connection ends the lease.

func (f Fixture) Clone(ctx context.Context, p Installation) (Database, error)
    Clone installs a template once per digest and clones it for one test.
    A shared advisory lock protects the template through the physical copy,
    allowing concurrent copies. Publication is serialized on the staging name.

func (f Fixture) CloneWithLease(ctx context.Context, p Installation, login *LoginRole) (Database, error)
    CloneWithLease creates a clone that PruneClones can reclaim after login's
    lease ends. Use a live login from the same maintenance database, close test
    clients and call Database.Drop during normal cleanup. If publication and
    cleanup both fail, the error comes with the database handle for a retry.

func (f Fixture) Prepare(ctx context.Context, p Installation) error
    Prepare installs and publishes the template for p, or refreshes its last-use
    mark if it already exists. It requires no login lease and creates no test
    clone. Call Prepare before acquiring a login whose member roles are created
    by the installation.

func (f Fixture) Prune(ctx context.Context, maxIdle time.Duration, keep ...Installation) ([]string, error)
    Prune drops cached templates whose last use is older than maxIdle and
    staging databases abandoned by interrupted builds, except the templates
    of keep. Prepare and both clone methods refresh the last-use mark.
    Prune takes the template lock exclusively before calling Backend.Drop.
    Templates with missing or invalid last-use marks are kept. Prune returns
    the names it dropped, including partial results if another drop failed.
    It also reaps process logins and leased clones observed idle for maxIdle.
    Its result contains only database names. PruneLoginRoles and PruneClones run
    the corresponding sweeps independently.

func (f Fixture) PruneClones(ctx context.Context, maxIdle time.Duration) ([]string, error)
    PruneClones removes abandoned CloneWithLease databases owned by this
    maintenance database. A live lease or any connection preserves the clone.
    A positive maxIdle starts at the first observed idle sweep; zero requests
    immediate cleanup. It returns names removed by this call and any errors.

func (f Fixture) PruneLoginRoles(ctx context.Context, maxIdle time.Duration) ([]string, error)
    PruneLoginRoles removes abandoned fixture logins from this maintenance
    database's namespace, including logins with no surviving clone. A positive
    maxIdle starts at the first prune that observes both the lease and all
    client sessions gone. Zero reclaims them immediately. It returns the names
    removed by this call and any cleanup errors. Fixture.Prune applies its own
    maxIdle.

type Installation struct {
	Revision   string
	Base       []byte
	Migrations []Migration
}
    Installation describes an ordered install. Include base dumps, install
    settings and installer revisions affecting the result in Base and Revision.

func (p Installation) TemplateName() (string, error)
    TemplateName hashes length-framed install inputs into a PostgreSQL
    identifier.

func (p Installation) Through(name string) (Installation, error)
    Through returns the inclusive prefix ending at name, preserving install
    order.

type LoginRole struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    LoginRole owns a session advisory lock on a dedicated maintenance
    connection. It can be used across multiple clones and test cases until
    Release. The admin pool needs one slot per live login in addition to its
    working slots.

func (r *LoginRole) Name() string
    Name returns the generated PostgreSQL login name.

func (r *LoginRole) Password() string
    Password returns the random login password. It returns an empty string after
    Release has been called. Pass it directly to the test client's connection
    settings and keep credentials out of logs and fixture files.

func (r *LoginRole) Release(ctx context.Context) error
    Release removes the login and its direct database CONNECT grants. Close
    its business connections first. The first call retires the credentials and
    disposes of the pinned backend even on error. A later Release or Prune can
    retry cleanup. Releasing an already removed login succeeds.

type LoginRoleOptions struct {
	MemberOf        []string
	Inherit         bool
	ConnectionLimit *int
	// Label optionally appends 1–25 ASCII lowercase letters, digits or
	// underscores to the generated name. Empty preserves the unlabeled form.
	Label string
}
    LoginRoleOptions configures a temporary LOGIN on a disposable cluster.
    MemberOf lists exact catalog names of existing roles. Inherit defaults
    to false. ConnectionLimit defaults to unlimited (nil or -1); zero denies
    ordinary connections. The login receives no administrative attributes.

type Migration struct {
	Name    string
	Content []byte
}
    Migration carries the stable name and exact input bytes of one migration.

```

package pqdriver // import "github.com/0xJean/tabula/pqdriver"

Package pqdriver provides lib/pq-backed array converters for Tabula.

FUNCTIONS

func Array(v any) any
