## sqlcheck

```text
package sqlcheck // import "github.com/0xJean/tabula/sqlcheck"

Package sqlcheck verifies PostgreSQL descriptors, handwritten SQL and role
workloads. It checks schema alignment, snapshots database catalogs, compares
direct grants, trials revocations, classifies policies and tests RLS behavior.

VARIABLES

var ErrDescribeRequired = errors.New("sqlcheck: non-executing result description is required")
    ErrDescribeRequired reports that a statement's result cannot be checked
    without a non-executing protocol description. In particular, LIMIT 0 is not
    a safe substitute for describing a statement containing a modifying CTE.


FUNCTIONS

func CheckLoginRole(ctx context.Context, db *sql.DB, exp LoginRoleExpectation) ([]string, error)
    CheckLoginRole audits exp.Role on db and returns sorted human-readable
    violation lines. An empty slice indicates a compliant login role.

func CheckPolicyCoverage(ctx context.Context, db *sql.DB, work RoleStatements) ([]string, error)
    CheckPolicyCoverage reads pg_policy for each required command. It checks
    permissive rules, ALL/PUBLIC and inherited memberships, and flags bypassing
    roles on RLS tables. A top-level row-locking clause on a simple SELECT
    also requires UPDATE coverage. Predicates are exercised separately by
    RunRLSMatrix.

func CheckRLS(ctx context.Context, db *sql.DB, exp RLSExpectation) ([]string, error)
    CheckRLS audits PostgreSQL RLS configuration in exp.Schema against exp and
    returns sorted human-readable failure lines.

func CheckRolePrivileges(ctx context.Context, db *sql.DB, needs PrivilegeNeeds, role string) (missing, extra []string, err error)
    CheckRolePrivileges compares a PostgreSQL role's actual grants on db against
    needs, returning sorted missing and extra privilege descriptions.

func CheckSchemaColumns(def tabula.Definition, installed map[string]ColumnInfo, families map[string][]string) []string
    CheckSchemaColumns compares one descriptor Definition against the installed
    PostgreSQL columns for its table or view and returns human-readable mismatch
    lines.

func ClassifyPolicies(policies []Policy, rules []PolicyRule) ([]PolicyClass, []string, error)
    ClassifyPolicies requires exactly one rule per policy and reports every
    registered identity that no longer satisfies its rule. It has no built-in
    roles.

func CollectPrivilegeNeeds(defs []tabula.Definition) (PrivilegeNeeds, []string)
    CollectPrivilegeNeeds merges descriptor and typed-shape grants and reports
    definitions with unspecified grants. A plan source explicitly declares
    zero baseline grants, including when all its reads belong to views. Use
    RoleStatements.Readiness for a role's selected shapes, including any-column,
    schema and RLS requirements.

func DefaultTypeFamilies() map[string][]string
    DefaultTypeFamilies returns a fresh copy of the built-in Go-type to
    PostgreSQL information_schema data_type family map. Callers may extend
    the returned map with application-specific named types before calling
    CheckSchemaColumns or VerifySchema.

func FirstDifference(want, got string) string
    FirstDifference returns up to 40 diff lines showing the first mismatches
    between want and got.

func ParseSnapshot(content string) ([]tabula.Definition, error)
    ParseSnapshot parses a SQL snapshot previously rendered by RenderSnapshot
    into named statements and their recorded query ownership. Standalone tools
    such as tabula check can verify the snapshot against PostgreSQL without
    importing the application's Go packages.

func PrepareStatement(ctx context.Context, tx *sql.Tx, query, role string) error
    PrepareStatement has the server PREPARE query inside tx, optionally as role,
    then EXPLAIN EXECUTE it with NULL arguments. PREPARE checks names, types,
    functions and parameter inference. EXPLAIN checks plan-time access without
    executing the statement. Runtime function and sequence use needs execution
    probes. Row-level security policies are not evaluated. Everything is undone
    through a savepoint, so tx stays usable for the next statement.

func RenderAllSnapshot(tables []tabula.Definition, views []tabula.ViewDefinition, headerLines ...string) string
    RenderAllSnapshot renders both table Definitions and ViewDefinitions into
    one deterministic SQL snapshot.

func RenderSnapshot(defs []tabula.Definition, headerLines ...string) string
    RenderSnapshot formats every statement across defs deterministically
    (sorted by table name, then statement key), prefixed by headerLines (each
    written as a "-- " comment line). A header records the owning query of each
    composed-query statement so role bindings survive a snapshot round trip.

func RunRLSMatrix(ctx context.Context, db *sql.DB, m RLSMatrix) ([]string, error)
    RunRLSMatrix executes application SQL against a disposable fixture and rolls
    back each cell independently. Findings are sorted. Transaction setup and
    rollback errors are returned separately from assertion failures.

func VerifyRoleStatements(ctx context.Context, db *sql.DB, work RoleStatements) ([]string, error)
    VerifyRoleStatements prepares and explains each role's SQL in a rolled-back
    transaction. Findings identify the role and statement and are sorted.

func VerifyRoleStatementsUsing(ctx context.Context, verifier Verifier, work RoleStatements) (findings []string, err error)
    VerifyRoleStatementsUsing prepares, describes and explains each role's SQL
    through a non-executing verification backend. Result-bearing writes require
    Describe; they are never wrapped in a SELECT probe. Findings are sorted.

func VerifySchema(ctx context.Context, db *sql.DB, defs []tabula.Definition, families map[string][]string) ([]string, error)
    VerifySchema inspects PostgreSQL columns on db for every Definition in defs
    (supporting tables, partitioned tables, regular views, and materialized
    views) and returns all column mismatches.

func VerifyStatements(ctx context.Context, db *sql.DB, defs []tabula.Definition, role string) ([]string, error)
    VerifyStatements prepares and explains every statement of defs as role
    (empty means the connection's own role) inside one rolled-back transaction
    and returns one line per failing statement, sorted. A result-bearing write
    returns ErrDescribeRequired; use VerifyStatementsUsing with a protocol
    backend.

func VerifyStatementsUsing(ctx context.Context, verifier Verifier, defs []tabula.Definition, role string) ([]string, error)
    VerifyStatementsUsing verifies every registered statement through verifier.
    An empty role retains the connection's own role. A database/sql verifier can
    check legacy reads, but typed write results require a Describe backend.

func VerifyViewSchema(ctx context.Context, db *sql.DB, views []tabula.ViewDefinition, families map[string][]string) ([]string, error)
    VerifyViewSchema verifies column alignment for views (including PostgreSQL
    regular views and materialized views) against db.

func VerifyViewStatements(ctx context.Context, db *sql.DB, views []tabula.ViewDefinition, role string) ([]string, error)
    VerifyViewStatements prepares and explains every registered statement across
    views as role inside one rolled-back transaction.

func ViewsToDefinitions(views []tabula.ViewDefinition) []tabula.Definition
    ViewsToDefinitions converts ViewDefinitions into Definitions so they
    can be passed to RenderSnapshot, VerifyStatements, VerifySchema,
    or CollectPrivilegeNeeds.


TYPES

type BehaviorCase struct {
	Role, Scope, Statement string
	Rows                   [][]*string
	Ordered                bool              `json:",omitempty"`
	Affected               *int64            `json:",omitempty"`
	Denied                 tabula.ErrorClass `json:",omitempty"`
}
    BehaviorCase expects exactly one outcome. Rows are PostgreSQL values scanned
    as text, with nil for SQL NULL. Unordered comparison preserves duplicates.

type BehaviorStatement struct {
	SQL  string
	Args []any
}
    BehaviorStatement executes once per role and scope, with bound arguments.

type CallSite struct {
	Package  string
	File     string
	Line     int
	Symbol   string
	Category string `json:",omitempty"`
	Escaped  bool   `json:",omitempty"`
}
    CallSite records one resolved reference or invocation of a CallTarget.
    Escaped is true when a function or method is referenced as a value rather
    than called directly.

type CallTarget struct {
	Package  string
	Receiver string `json:",omitempty"`
	Name     string
	Field    bool   `json:",omitempty"`
	Category string `json:",omitempty"`
}
    CallTarget matches a Go package-level function (Receiver == ""), method
    (Receiver != ""), or struct field (Field == true) by canonical package path
    and symbol name. Field targets also match selections promoted by embedding.

func DefaultSecurityCallTargets() []CallTarget
    DefaultSecurityCallTargets returns the built-in security-review call
    targets: session keys, registry sealing, proof signing, keyed runner/Direct
    factories, nested-transaction marker helpers, and both drivers' raw
    transaction access.

type Catalog struct {
	Policies []Policy
	ForceRLS []Relation
	Grants   []Grant
	Definers []Definer
}
    Catalog holds one repeatable-read snapshot. Policies, force flags and
    definers cover all objects in the selected schemas, regardless of grantee.

func ReadCatalog(ctx context.Context, db *sql.DB, scope CatalogScope) (Catalog, error)
    ReadCatalog reads the scoped PostgreSQL catalogs with a fixed deparser
    search path. Definers includes SECURITY DEFINER functions and procedures.
    Grants includes overloaded functions and explicit column grants.

func (c Catalog) Snapshots() map[string]string
    Snapshots renders each catalog section as independently comparable JSON.

type CatalogScope struct {
	Schemas     []string
	Roles       []string
	Granularity GrantGranularity `json:",omitempty"`
}
    CatalogScope names the complete set of schemas and direct grantees in an
    audit. PUBLIC includes privileges granted to everyone. Granularity defaults
    to GranularityAll (including column ACLs) and may be set to GranularityTable
    to audit table, sequence and function grants only.

type ColumnInfo struct {
	DataType string
	Nullable bool
}
    ColumnInfo is one PostgreSQL column as read from information_schema.columns
    or pg_catalog.pg_attribute (for materialized views).

type Definer struct{ Schema, Name, Arguments, Owner, Definition string }
    Definer records the owner, signature, body and settings of a SECURITY
    DEFINER routine.

type DescribedField struct {
	Name      string
	TypeOID   uint32
	TypeMod   int32
	TableOID  uint32
	Attribute int16
}
    DescribedField is a PostgreSQL RowDescription field. TableOID and Attribute
    may be zero for computed values. PostgreSQL may report a domain's base type;
    TypeOID alone does not establish its logical domain identity or nullability.

type Description struct {
	Parameters []uint32
	Fields     []DescribedField
}
    Description contains a prepared statement's parameter OIDs and ordered wire
    result fields. Server-local OIDs are evidence for this verification only and
    must not be persisted as portable schema identities.

type Grant struct {
	Role, Schema, Kind, Object, Privilege string
	Column                                string `json:",omitempty"`
	Arguments                             string `json:",omitempty"`
	GrantOption                           bool   `json:",omitempty"`
}
    Grant is a direct ACL entry. Kind is TABLE, COLUMN, SEQUENCE or FUNCTION.
    FUNCTION covers ordinary, aggregate and window functions. Procedure EXECUTE
    grants are outside the manifest and minimization scope. Arguments uses
    schema-qualified PostgreSQL type names from the snapshot, including the
    array type name for variadic functions. Grantor is immaterial.

type GrantDiff struct {
	Missing, Extra []Grant
	SQL            []string
}
    GrantDiff contains both sides of the discrepancy and reviewable repair SQL.

func CheckGrantManifest(ctx context.Context, db *sql.DB, m GrantManifest) (GrantDiff, error)
    CheckGrantManifest compares a declaration against every supported object in
    its schemas.

func CompareGrants(manifest GrantManifest, actual []Grant) (GrantDiff, error)
    CompareGrants computes exact direct ACL differences, including grant
    options. PostgreSQL revokes same-privilege column ACLs when revoking from
    a table; surviving explicit column grants are restored in the generated
    script. Under GranularityTable, COLUMN grants in the manifest or actual
    slice are rejected.

type GrantGranularity string
    GrantGranularity selects which PostgreSQL ACL object kinds are included in
    catalog reads, grant comparisons and grant minimization.

const (
	// GranularityAll audits TABLE, COLUMN, SEQUENCE and FUNCTION direct grants (default).
	GranularityAll GrantGranularity = ""
	// GranularityTable audits TABLE, SEQUENCE and FUNCTION direct grants, omitting column ACLs.
	GranularityTable GrantGranularity = "table"
)
func ParseGrantGranularity(raw string) (GrantGranularity, error)
    ParseGrantGranularity parses a configuration or CLI granularity value ("all"
    or "table").

type GrantManifest struct {
	CatalogScope
	Grants []Grant
}
    GrantManifest declares the exact grants expected in its CatalogScope.

type InventoryConfig struct {
	Dir      string
	Patterns []string
	Tags     string
	// Tests includes internal and external _test.go files in matching packages.
	Tests          bool
	Methods        []SQLMethod
	RoutineMethods []SQLRoutineMethod `json:",omitempty"`
	Exceptions     map[string]string
	// CallTargets collects typed references to package-level functions, methods,
	// and struct fields for review (reported in SQLInventory.CallSites).
	CallTargets []CallTarget
	// AuditSecurityCalls adds DefaultSecurityCallTargets() to CallTargets.
	AuditSecurityCalls bool
}
    InventoryConfig selects buildable Go packages, SQL methods, call targets,
    and reviewed site exceptions. Patterns default to ./... in Dir. Tags use the
    Go build tag syntax.

type LoginRoleExpectation struct {
	// Role is the PostgreSQL login role name to audit (required).
	Role string
	// MemberOf is the exact set of roles that Role is allowed to be a direct
	// member of.
	MemberOf []string
	// Schemas lists the schemas where Role must not have CREATE privilege.
	// Defaults to ["public"] when empty.
	Schemas []string
}
    LoginRoleExpectation configures PostgreSQL login-role hygiene verification
    (A8). A compliant application login role has LOGIN NOINHERIT, no privileged
    attributes, exact expected role memberships (the NOLOGIN roles it switches
    into via SET LOCAL ROLE) with per-grant INHERIT disabled on PostgreSQL 16+,
    no direct table or column grants, owns no database objects, and cannot
    CREATE in the selected schemas.

type MinimizeConfig struct {
	Role        string
	Schemas     []string
	Granularity GrantGranularity `json:",omitempty"`
	Statements  []Statement
	Keep        []Grant
	// Current, if supplied, must match the live direct ACL exactly.
	Current []Grant
	// Runtime probes supplement planning for specified privileges.
	Runtime []RuntimeProbe
}
    MinimizeConfig selects one role and its complete planning workload.
    Keep pins runtime requirements, including requirements from outside the
    workload. Granularity defaults to GranularityAll (TABLE, COLUMN, SEQUENCE,
    FUNCTION) and may be set to GranularityTable to trial only TABLE, SEQUENCE
    and FUNCTION grants.

type Minimum struct {
	Kept, Removed, Unverified []Grant
	GrantSQL, RevokeSQL       []string
}
    Minimum records a deterministic, inclusion-minimal set for the tested
    DML privileges, plus pinned and unobservable privileges. Unverified lists
    surviving privileges for which planning alone is insufficient evidence.

func MinimizeGrants(ctx context.Context, db *sql.DB, cfg MinimizeConfig) (Minimum, error)
    MinimizeGrants tries cumulative RESTRICT revocations in an
    always-rolled-back transaction. It verifies the baseline, each candidate and
    the final workload. A trial that fails for a non-permission reason aborts
    the audit.

type MissingRequirement struct {
	Kind, Object, Column, Privilege string
}
    MissingRequirement identifies one unmet capability. Column is set for a
    named column grant or its owned sequence. Kind is ROLE, SCHEMA, TABLE,
    COLUMN, SEQUENCE, FUNCTION, KEY, COMPARISON, UNIQUE or CONFLICT. A missing
    role produces only the ROLE/EXISTS finding.

func CheckReadiness(ctx context.Context, db *sql.DB, role string, needs ...ReadinessNeeds) ([]MissingRequirement, error)
    CheckReadiness checks the union of all needs for role in one catalog query.
    It returns sorted missing capabilities, including absent objects. Use
    CheckRolePrivileges for an audit that also reports extra grants.

type Policy struct {
	PolicyID
	Command      string
	Permissive   bool
	Roles        []string
	Using, Check string
}
    Policy contains the server-deparsed conditions and explicit target roles.

type PolicyAccess struct{ Table, Command string }
    PolicyAccess names a relation (PostgreSQL regclass spelling) and a command
    requiring a permissive policy for the execution role.

type PolicyClass struct {
	PolicyID
	Rule string
}
    PolicyClass records the unique matching rule for a policy.

type PolicyID struct {
	Relation
	Name string
}
    PolicyID identifies a policy within its table.

type PolicyRule struct {
	Name, Command, Using, Check string
	Expression, NotExpression   string `json:",omitempty"`
	Permissive                  *bool
	Roles                       []string
	Entries                     []PolicyID
	// Patterns match individual identifiers. UnregisteredOnly excludes policy
	// identities explicitly registered in any rule's Entries.
	SchemaPattern, TablePattern, NamePattern string
	UnregisteredOnly                         bool
}
    PolicyRule matches the conjunction of its nonempty fields. Roles is an exact
    set; Using and Check are Go regular expressions over server-deparsed SQL.
    Expression and NotExpression match (or exclude) the combined USING and WITH
    CHECK predicates (Using + "\n" + Check). Entries, when present, restricts
    the rule to registered policy identities.

type PrivilegeNeeds struct {
	Columns     map[string]map[string]map[string]bool
	TableDelete map[string]bool
	Sequences   [][2]string
	Functions   []string
}
    PrivilegeNeeds aggregates column, table-DELETE, sequence, and function
    EXECUTE privileges required across a set of descriptor Definitions.

type RLSExpectation struct {
	// Schema is the PostgreSQL schema to inspect (defaults to "public").
	Schema string
	// Tables lists unqualified table names in Schema that must have RLS enabled.
	// When empty, every table in Schema that already has RLS enabled is audited.
	Tables []string
	// RequireForce fails any checked table without FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY.
	RequireForce bool
	// RequireRestrictive fails any checked table that has no RESTRICTIVE policy.
	RequireRestrictive bool
	// ForbiddenPolicyRoles fails any policy in Schema whose polroles directly
	// names one of these roles (e.g. a login or grant-holder role).
	ForbiddenPolicyRoles []string
}
    RLSExpectation configures domain-agnostic PostgreSQL Row-Level Security
    structural checks against pg_class and pg_policy.

type RLSMatrix struct {
	Roles      []string
	Scopes     map[string]map[string]string
	Statements map[string]BehaviorStatement
	Cases      []BehaviorCase
}
    RLSMatrix requires one expectation for every role × scope × statement cell.
    Scopes contain application-owned custom GUC values.

type ReadinessNeeds struct {
	Privileges      PrivilegeNeeds
	SchemaUsage     []string
	TableSelect     []string                        // table-level SELECT via has_table_privilege
	TableInsert     []string                        // table-level INSERT via has_table_privilege
	TableUpdate     []string                        // table-level UPDATE via has_table_privilege
	TableDelete     []string                        // table-level DELETE via has_table_privilege
	AnyColumnSelect []string                        // SELECT on at least one column of each relation
	AnyColumnUpdate []string                        // UPDATE on at least one column of each locked relation
	Routines        []tabula.RoutineRequirement     // exact function catalog contracts
	ForceRLS        []string                        // both ENABLE and FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
	SequenceUsage   []string                        // named sequences in addition to column-owned sequences
	Keys            []tabula.KeyRequirement         // immediate primary-key premises
	Comparisons     []tabula.ComparisonRequirement  // native ordering and deterministic collations
	UniqueMatches   []tabula.UniqueMatchRequirement // immediate unique write-source premises
	Defaults        []tabula.DefaultRequirement     // actual default sequence dependencies, including omitted physical columns
	Conflicts       []tabula.ConflictRequirement    // native conflict-arbiter catalog premises
}
    ReadinessNeeds describes minimum capabilities for one role. Privileges
    accepts the result of CollectPrivilegeNeeds. Relations and function
    signatures must be schema-qualified. Schema and column names are their exact
    catalog names.

type Relation struct{ Schema, Table string }
    Relation identifies one schema-qualified PostgreSQL relation.

type RoleStatements map[string][]Statement
    RoleStatements maps each execution role to its own named probes.

func (r RoleStatements) AddDefinitions(role string, defs ...tabula.Definition)
    AddDefinitions appends every statement from defs (in deterministic sorted
    order, including C1 count_by_<col> statements) to role's workload.

func (r RoleStatements) AddViews(role string, views ...tabula.ViewDefinition)
    AddViews appends every registered statement from views (including all C3
    composed-query variants) to role's workload without manual listing.

func (r RoleStatements) Readiness(role string) (ReadinessNeeds, error)
    Readiness collects minimum privileges and scope requirements from the
    registered shapes bound to role. Pass the result and any application
    requirements to CheckReadiness. Legacy SQL retains its application-owned
    needs.

type RuntimeProbe struct {
	BehaviorStatement
	Vars   map[string]string
	Covers []Grant
}
    RuntimeProbe is a positive execution witness on a disposable fixture.
    Covers names the runtime privileges for which the application considers
    it evidence. Each probe runs as Role with Vars in a separate rolled-back
    savepoint.

type SQLBinding struct {
	Roles      []string
	Access     []PolicyAccess
	NoAccess   bool `json:",omitempty"`
	Variants   []Statement
	Definition string `json:",omitempty"`
	// Plan identifies a registered typed family when the source handle is indirect.
	Plan   string `json:",omitempty"`
	Prefix string `json:",omitempty"`
	Skip   bool
}
    SQLBinding assigns one inventoried site to its execution roles. Definition
    names the owning table or view when the collector cannot resolve it. Prefix
    optionally narrows the registered variants of one plan. Manual Variants
    carry their own Access or NoAccess requirements. Skip requires a registered
    exception.

type SQLInventory struct {
	Sites     []SQLSite
	CallSites []CallSite `json:",omitempty"`
	Findings  []string
}
    SQLInventory retains reviewed sites, typed security/factory call sites,
    and reports unreviewed dynamic SQL and stale exceptions.

func CollectSQL(ctx context.Context, cfg InventoryConfig) (SQLInventory, error)
    CollectSQL resolves Go types and constants using the installed Go toolchain,
    including aliases and imported constants. It recognizes View.DefineQuery,
    View.TryDefineQuery, and single-table aggregate calls (Max, Min, Sum,
    Avg, CountBy, Exists) as static sites when their key or column is
    compile-time constant, and collects typed call sites for CallTargets /
    AuditSecurityCalls. Typed row declarations and executions are built-in
    sites. Indirect plan handles can be resolved through SQLBinding.Definition
    and SQLBinding.Plan. Raw SQL methods and additional call targets are
    optional.

func (inv SQLInventory) BindRoles(bindings map[string]SQLBinding) (RoleStatements, error)
    BindRoles produces a workload from the collected SQL. Missing and stale
    assignments, unreviewed dynamic sites and empty workloads fail validation.

func (inv SQLInventory) BindRolesWithDefinitions(
	bindings map[string]SQLBinding,
	defs []tabula.Definition,
	views []tabula.ViewDefinition,
) (RoleStatements, error)
    BindRolesWithDefinitions expands composed queries, aggregates and typed
    plans against their owning definitions. A missing owner, ambiguous
    definition, or site with no matching statements returns an error and no
    partial workload. Supply named Variants for SQL that is not registered in a
    definition.

type SQLMethod struct {
	Receiver, Method string
	Argument         int
}
    SQLMethod matches the package-qualified receiver type (without pointer or
    generic arguments). Argument is the zero-based SQL position in a method
    call.

type SQLRoutineMethod struct {
	Receiver     string
	Method       string
	NameArgument int
	ArgsArgument int
	Schema       string `json:",omitempty"`
	SetReturning bool   `json:",omitempty"`
}
    SQLRoutineMethod matches a method call that invokes a PostgreSQL routine by
    name and positional argument slice rather than raw SQL text. NameArgument
    and ArgsArgument are zero-based positions of fixed parameters after the
    receiver. A nil or dense slice literal supplies the arity. Trailing variadic
    result destinations do not affect it. Schema defaults to "public". When
    SetReturning is true, static calls emit SELECT * FROM <schema>.<name>($1,
    ...); otherwise SELECT <schema>.<name>($1, ...).

type SQLSite struct {
	ID, File         string
	Line             int
	Receiver, Method string
	SQL              string `json:",omitempty"`
	QueryKey         string `json:",omitempty"`
	// Definition is the owning descriptor when its name is resolved from source.
	Definition string `json:",omitempty"`
	// NoFilter records a scalar aggregate call with an explicit nil where argument.
	// Only these calls can use the aggregate SQL from a descriptor snapshot.
	NoFilter  bool   `json:",omitempty"`
	Kind      string `json:",omitempty"`
	Dynamic   bool   `json:",omitempty"`
	Exception string `json:",omitempty"`
}
    SQLSite describes an SQL call or a registered statement declaration or use.
    Typed row families, including locking reads, use Kind "typed_rows".
    Transaction advisory locks and routine plans use "typed_plan" with the
    declaring function or concrete method receiver. ID is independent of line
    numbers.

type Statement struct {
	Name     string
	SQL      string
	Access   []PolicyAccess `json:",omitempty"`
	NoAccess bool           `json:",omitempty"`
	// Shape carries per-statement types and readiness requirements exported by a typed plan.
	Shape *tabula.StatementShape `json:",omitempty"`
}
    Statement is application-owned SQL. Access supplies the complete relation
    and command list for complex statements when checking structural policy
    coverage. NoAccess marks a reviewed complex statement (such as a SECURITY
    DEFINER routine call) that touches no caller-context RLS relations.
    Coverage rejects an assertion that conflicts with inferred table access.
    The reviewer checks dependencies inside routines and other SQL outside the
    inference rules.

type VerificationTx interface {
	Exec(ctx context.Context, sql string, args ...any) error
	Scan(ctx context.Context, sql string, args []any, dest ...any) error
	Each(ctx context.Context, sql string, args []any, visit func(scan func(...any) error) error) error
	Describe(ctx context.Context, statementName, sql string) (Description, error)
	Rollback(context.Context) error
}
    VerificationTx is the standard-library-only connection contract for
    statement verification. Describe must parse and describe without executing
    the supplied statement. Rollback releases the transaction and all connection
    resources.

type Verifier interface {
	BeginVerification(context.Context) (VerificationTx, error)
}
    Verifier begins an isolated read-only verification transaction.
    Implementations keep catalog reads, role setup, statement description and
    EXPLAIN on the same connection. This capability grants no runtime statement
    authority.

```

## stdsql

```text
package stdsql // import "github.com/0xJean/tabula/stdsql"

Package stdsql provides role-bound database/sql transaction runners, guarded
sessions, scope/RLS policies, savepoints, and read-only Direct pools for tabula.
It depends only on the Go standard library and github.com/0xJean/tabula.

FUNCTIONS

func SetLocalConfig(ctx context.Context, tx *sql.Tx, key, value string) error
    SetLocalConfig sets a PostgreSQL transaction-local GUC via set_config(...,
    true).

func SetLocalRole(ctx context.Context, tx *sql.Tx, role string) error
    SetLocalRole switches the PostgreSQL role for the duration of tx.


TYPES

type DirectOption func(*directConfig)
    DirectOption customizes a read-only DirectPool created by Direct.

func DirectObserver(obs *tabula.Observer) DirectOption
    DirectObserver attaches a session-level Observer to a DirectPool.

func DirectSQLAuthority(a tabula.SQLAuthority) DirectOption
    DirectSQLAuthority binds the pool to registered calls issued by a registry.
    A strict credential also rejects direct SQL text on every session of the
    pool.

func DirectSessionKey(key tabula.SessionKey) DirectOption
    DirectSessionKey binds a SessionKey to a DirectPool so every pointer
    returned by DirectPool.Session carries a valid SessionProof for A4 sealed
    registries.

type DirectPool[S any] struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    DirectPool owns a database/sql pool of read-only PostgreSQL connections.

func Direct[S any](driverName, postgresURL string, policy ScopePolicy[S], opts ...DirectOption) (*DirectPool[S], error)
    Direct opens a dedicated read-only pool from a PostgreSQL URL and a
    registered database/sql driver (for example "postgres"). Call Session to
    bind each request and Close at shutdown. Managed transaction-local variables
    require a Runner.

func (p *DirectPool[S]) Close() error
    Close releases the underlying connection pool.

func (p *DirectPool[S]) Session(scope S) tabula.Session[S]
    Session binds the scope without opening a transaction or checking out a
    connection.

func (p *DirectPool[S]) SetConnMaxIdleTime(d time.Duration)
    SetConnMaxIdleTime sets the maximum amount of time a connection may be idle.

func (p *DirectPool[S]) SetConnMaxLifetime(d time.Duration)
    SetConnMaxLifetime sets the maximum amount of time a connection may be
    reused.

func (p *DirectPool[S]) SetMaxIdleConns(n int)
    SetMaxIdleConns sets the maximum number of idle connections in the pool.

func (p *DirectPool[S]) SetMaxOpenConns(n int)
    SetMaxOpenConns sets the maximum number of open connections to the database.

func (p *DirectPool[S]) Stats() sql.DBStats
    Stats returns database/sql pool statistics.

type RawSession[S any] struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    RawSession wraps a *Session[S] with explicit raw *sql.Tx escape access.
    It is constructed only when RunnerOptions.ExposeTx is true via
    Runner.WithinRaw.

func (s *RawSession[S]) Each(ctx context.Context, query string, args []any, decode func(func(...any) error) error) error
    Each streams all rows of query through decode.

func (s *RawSession[S]) EachAuthorized(ctx context.Context, call tabula.AuthorizedStatement, visit func(func(...any) error) error) error
    EachAuthorized verifies a registered streaming call for this instance.

func (s *RawSession[S]) Exec(ctx context.Context, query string, args ...any) (int64, error)
    Exec executes a statement and returns its affected row count.

func (s *RawSession[S]) ExecAuthorized(ctx context.Context, call tabula.AuthorizedStatement) (int64, error)
    ExecAuthorized verifies a registered mutation for this raw-session instance.

func (s *RawSession[S]) ReadOnly() bool
    ReadOnly reports whether this handle permits only reads.

func (s *RawSession[S]) Returning(ctx context.Context, query string, args []any, dest ...any) error
    Returning executes a write with RETURNING and scans the returned row into
    dest.

func (s *RawSession[S]) SQLAuthority() tabula.SQLAuthority
    SQLAuthority returns the credential of the underlying session.

func (s *RawSession[S]) Savepoint(ctx context.Context, name string, fn func(context.Context) error) error
    Savepoint runs fn inside a PostgreSQL SAVEPOINT on the underlying
    transaction.

func (s *RawSession[S]) Scan(ctx context.Context, query string, args []any, dest ...any) error
    Scan executes a single-row query and scans into dest.

func (s *RawSession[S]) ScanAuthorized(ctx context.Context, call tabula.AuthorizedStatement, dest ...any) error
    ScanAuthorized verifies a registered single-row call for this instance.

func (s *RawSession[S]) Scope() S
    Scope returns the session's bound scope value.

func (s *RawSession[S]) Session() *Session[S]
    Session returns the underlying guarded *Session[S].

func (s *RawSession[S]) SessionProof() tabula.SessionProof
    SessionProof returns the instance-bound proof for this *RawSession[S].

func (s *RawSession[S]) TabulaObserved() tabula.ObserveMask
    TabulaObserved reports which observability signals this session owns.

func (s *RawSession[S]) Tx() *sql.Tx
    Tx returns the underlying *sql.Tx. Only available on *RawSession[S].

func (s *RawSession[S]) Unscoped() bool
    Unscoped reports whether this session bypasses row-level scope predicates.

func (s *RawSession[S]) WithinOperation(ctx context.Context, fn func(context.Context, tabula.Session[S]) error) error
    WithinOperation delegates to the guarded transaction handle. The operation
    callback receives a guarded child without a raw transaction escape.

type RunOptions[S any] struct {
	TxOptions    *sql.TxOptions
	BeforeCommit func(context.Context, *Session[S]) error
}
    RunOptions customizes a single runner transaction invocation, including an
    optional BeforeCommit step that receives a fresh session handle after the
    body handle is closed.

type Runner[S any] struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    Runner opens role-bound, guarded PostgreSQL transactions on a *sql.DB and
    binds them to Session[S] handles.

func NewRunner[S any](db *sql.DB, policy ScopePolicy[S], opts RunnerOptions) (*Runner[S], error)
    NewRunner validates policy and opts and creates a guarded Runner backed by
    db.

func (r *Runner[S]) Within(ctx context.Context, scope S, fn func(context.Context, *Session[S]) error) error
    Within runs fn in a read-write transaction with the database default
    isolation. A top-level commit error matches tabula.ErrCommit and wraps its
    driver cause. On a ReadOnly runner, Within returns tabula.ErrReadOnly before
    BEGIN.

func (r *Runner[S]) WithinIsolation(ctx context.Context, scope S, level sql.IsolationLevel, fn func(context.Context, *Session[S]) error) error
    WithinIsolation runs fn in a read-write transaction with the requested
    isolation level.

func (r *Runner[S]) WithinOptions(ctx context.Context, scope S, opts *sql.TxOptions, fn func(context.Context, *Session[S]) error) error
    WithinOptions runs fn inside a transaction started with opts.

func (r *Runner[S]) WithinRaw(ctx context.Context, scope S, fn func(context.Context, *RawSession[S]) error) error
    WithinRaw runs fn with a *RawSession[S] exposing Tx() *sql.Tx. Requires
    RunnerOptions.ExposeTx == true; otherwise returns tabula.ErrCapabilityDenied
    before BEGIN.

func (r *Runner[S]) WithinRawOptions(ctx context.Context, scope S, opts *sql.TxOptions, fn func(context.Context, *RawSession[S]) error) error
    WithinRawOptions runs fn with a *RawSession[S] under explicit sql.TxOptions.

func (r *Runner[S]) WithinReadOnly(ctx context.Context, scope S, fn func(context.Context, *Session[S]) error) error
    WithinReadOnly runs fn in a READ ONLY transaction. The runner establishes
    the first PostgreSQL snapshot before calling fn, even with an empty policy.

func (r *Runner[S]) WithinRetry(ctx context.Context, scope S, cfg tabula.RetryConfig, fn func(context.Context, *Session[S]) error) error
    WithinRetry runs the full transaction attempt up to cfg.MaxAttempts times
    via tabula.Retry whenever the attempt fails with a retryable error.
    The callback must be idempotent apart from database writes.

func (r *Runner[S]) WithinRetryWith(ctx context.Context, scope S, cfg tabula.RetryConfig, runOpts RunOptions[S], fn func(context.Context, *Session[S]) error) error
    WithinRetryWith is WithinRetry with explicit RunOptions (isolation,
    read-only, BeforeCommit). Each retry that completes fn runs BeforeCommit
    once.

func (r *Runner[S]) WithinShared(ctx context.Context, fn func(context.Context, *Shared[S]) error) error
    WithinShared opens one transaction (read-write unless the runner is ReadOnly
    or opts specifies ReadOnly) that can switch between scoped and unscoped
    sessions via Shared.Scoped and Shared.Unscoped.

func (r *Runner[S]) WithinSharedOptions(ctx context.Context, opts *sql.TxOptions, fn func(context.Context, *Shared[S]) error) error
    WithinSharedOptions is WithinShared with explicit sql.TxOptions. With
    UnscopedReadRole configured, the runner restores Role before COMMIT.

func (r *Runner[S]) WithinWith(ctx context.Context, scope S, runOpts RunOptions[S], fn func(context.Context, *Session[S]) error) error
    WithinWith runs fn inside a transaction configured with runOpts, including
    an optional BeforeCommit step executed on a fresh handle before COMMIT.

type RunnerOptions struct {
	// RequireCallbackContext restricts live sessions to the runner callback's
	// context and its descendants. The default accepts any context.
	RequireCallbackContext bool
	// SingleStatement restricts session SQL to one data statement before driver I/O.
	SingleStatement bool
	// Statements restricts commands by method and implies SingleStatement when configured.
	Statements tabula.StatementPolicy
	// Role selects the transaction-local PostgreSQL role during setup when non-empty.
	Role string
	// RequireRole fails NewRunner when Role is empty.
	RequireRole bool
	// ReadOnly restricts this runner to READ ONLY transactions; read-write
	// requests fail closed with tabula.ErrReadOnly before BEGIN.
	ReadOnly bool
	// Unscoped controls whether unscoped sessions are denied, read-only, or
	// read-write.
	Unscoped UnscopedMode
	// UnscopedReadRole enables read-only unscoped handles within WithinShared.
	// Requires UnscopedReadOnly and a distinct scoped Role. Migrations must grant
	// this role read access only, including through functions and inherited grants.
	// An empty value keeps unscoped access restricted to READ ONLY transactions.
	UnscopedReadRole string
	// Timeouts bounds lock waits, statement duration, idle-in-transaction duration
	// and whole-attempt Go context duration.
	Timeouts Timeouts
	// SQLAuthority verifies descriptor calls from one registry. Its DenyLegacySQL
	// policy also disables raw session methods and raw transaction access.
	SQLAuthority tabula.SQLAuthority
	// SessionKey signs every Session created by this runner for A4 sealed
	// registries.
	SessionKey tabula.SessionKey
	// ExposeTx enables WithinRaw / WithinRawOptions returning *RawSession[S]
	// with Tx() *sql.Tx access. Default false removes raw transaction escape.
	ExposeTx bool
	// Tracer, Metrics, Log, Sanitize and TagStatements configure session-level
	// observability (B1/B3) for both descriptor and hand-written SQL.
	Tracer  tabula.Tracer
	Metrics tabula.Metrics
	Log     tabula.LogConfig
	// RawErrorDiagnostics passes original errors to the statement tracer. Driver
	// messages can contain bound values. The default traces the class and SQLSTATE.
	RawErrorDiagnostics bool
	// Sanitize supplies reviewed log text for errors. The default is the error class.
	Sanitize      func(error) string
	TagStatements bool
}
    RunnerOptions configures a role-bound, guarded stdsql.Runner.

type ScopePolicy[S any] struct {
	// ManagedVars declares the complete set of custom dotted GUC names managed by
	// this policy (for example "example.scope", "example.scope_mode",
	// "example.request_id"). All names are validated at construction and
	// protected automatically by the built-in session guard.
	ManagedVars []string
	// ScopeVars produces managed GUC key/value pairs for a scoped transaction.
	ScopeVars func(S) map[string]string
	// ContextVars produces managed GUC key/value pairs derived from ctx.
	ContextVars func(context.Context) map[string]string
	// IsUnscoped reports whether scope represents an unscoped call.
	IsUnscoped func(S) bool
	// UnscopedVars holds managed GUC key/value pairs applied in unscoped mode.
	UnscopedVars map[string]string
	// InactiveVars optionally specifies the inactive value written for managed
	// variables belonging to the opposite mode when switching inside WithinShared.
	// Unspecified managed variables default to "".
	InactiveVars map[string]string
	// GuardQuery optionally inspects every user SQL string before execution; it
	// composes with the runner's built-in session guard.
	GuardQuery func(query string) error
	// ScopeLog optionally formats scope values for session-level telemetry.
	ScopeLog func(S) string
}
    ScopePolicy configures transaction-local scope variables, context-derived
    variables, unscoped mode detection and SQL guards for a Runner.

func NoScopePolicy() ScopePolicy[struct{}]
    NoScopePolicy returns an empty ScopePolicy for applications that do not use
    row-level scoping.

type Session[S any] struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    Session implements tabula.Session[S] over one database/sql *sql.Tx without
    exposing the raw transaction. Overlapping statements or savepoint requests
    on the transaction return tabula.ErrSessionBusy, including inside Each.

func NewSession[S any](tx *sql.Tx, scope S, policy ScopePolicy[S]) *Session[S]
    NewSession wraps an existing *sql.Tx with scope and policy as an unsealed
    migration handle. Keyed registries require a Runner or keyed DirectPool.

func (s *Session[S]) Each(ctx context.Context, query string, args []any, visit func(func(...any) error) error) error
    Each streams rows on a runner that allows SQL text. The runner closes an
    unfinished cursor at transaction or savepoint exit.

func (s *Session[S]) EachAuthorized(ctx context.Context, call tabula.AuthorizedStatement, visit func(func(...any) error) error) error
    EachAuthorized streams a registered read or multirow write. A returning
    write uses the write policy and holds the cursor until iteration ends.

func (s *Session[S]) Exec(ctx context.Context, query string, args ...any) (int64, error)
    Exec executes SQL text on a runner that allows it.

func (s *Session[S]) ExecAuthorized(ctx context.Context, call tabula.AuthorizedStatement) (int64, error)
    ExecAuthorized executes a registered mutation and returns its affected-row
    count.

func (s *Session[S]) ReadOnly() bool
    ReadOnly reports whether this handle permits only reads.

func (s *Session[S]) Returning(ctx context.Context, query string, args []any, dest ...any) error
    Returning reads one row from a write on a runner that allows SQL text.

func (s *Session[S]) SQLAuthority() tabula.SQLAuthority
    SQLAuthority returns the registry credential configured on the runner.

func (s *Session[S]) Savepoint(ctx context.Context, name string, fn func(context.Context) error) (err error)
    Savepoint runs fn inside a PostgreSQL SAVEPOINT. On error or panic, changes
    made inside fn are rolled back to the savepoint while keeping the enclosing
    transaction usable; on success the savepoint is released.

func (s *Session[S]) Scan(ctx context.Context, query string, args []any, dest ...any) error
    Scan reads a single row on a runner that allows SQL text.

func (s *Session[S]) ScanAuthorized(ctx context.Context, call tabula.AuthorizedStatement, dest ...any) error
    ScanAuthorized decodes one result of a registered read or write. A write
    follows the runner's Returning policy.

func (s *Session[S]) Scope() S
    Scope returns the session's bound scope value.

func (s *Session[S]) SessionProof() tabula.SessionProof
    SessionProof returns the instance-bound proof for A4 sealed registries.

func (s *Session[S]) TabulaObserved() tabula.ObserveMask
    TabulaObserved reports which observability signals this session owns.

func (s *Session[S]) Unscoped() bool
    Unscoped reports whether this session bypasses row-level scope predicates.

func (s *Session[S]) WithinOperation(ctx context.Context, fn func(context.Context, tabula.Session[S]) error) (err error)
    WithinOperation runs fn in an operation savepoint. Its sealed child is
    the only usable handle until fn returns. Errors and panics roll back the
    operation; cleanup failure or cancellation discovered after a successful
    callback prevents the enclosing runner from committing.

type Shared[S any] struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    Shared exposes scoped and unscoped Session handles sharing a single
    transaction. Before every user statement on a child handle, the complete
    managed GUC state is reapplied in one batch (resetting the opposite mode's
    variables to their declared inactive value). This adds one round trip when
    variables are configured. UnscopedReadRole adds a separate SET LOCAL ROLE
    before each statement to select the handle's database role.

func (s *Shared[S]) Scoped(scope S) *Session[S]
    Scoped returns a scoped Session handle sharing this transaction.

func (s *Shared[S]) Unscoped() *Session[S]
    Unscoped returns an unscoped Session handle sharing this transaction.
    UnscopedReadOnly requires a READ ONLY transaction unless UnscopedReadRole is
    configured. That role permits Scan and Each while scoped handles use Role.
    UnscopedDenied rejects all operations with tabula.ErrCapabilityDenied.

type Timeouts struct {
	// Lock maps to PostgreSQL lock_timeout via set_config(..., true).
	Lock time.Duration
	// Statement maps to PostgreSQL statement_timeout via set_config(..., true).
	Statement time.Duration
	// IdleInTransaction maps to PostgreSQL idle_in_transaction_session_timeout.
	IdleInTransaction time.Duration
	// Transaction sets a Go context deadline before BEGIN for the whole attempt.
	// Zero inherits the caller's context; an earlier caller deadline wins.
	Transaction time.Duration
}
    Timeouts configures per-runner PostgreSQL transaction-local timeouts and an
    optional Go context deadline covering the entire attempt.

type UnscopedMode uint8
    UnscopedMode controls whether a Runner permits unscoped sessions.

const (
	// UnscopedDenied rejects every unscoped transaction before BEGIN (default).
	UnscopedDenied UnscopedMode = iota
	// UnscopedReadOnly permits unscoped reads in READ ONLY transactions or via
	// an explicitly configured UnscopedReadRole in WithinShared.
	UnscopedReadOnly
	// UnscopedReadWrite permits unscoped sessions in read-only and read-write transactions.
	UnscopedReadWrite
)
```

## CLI

```text
Usage: tabula <command> [flags]
  tabula check           Prepare and explain statements from a SQL snapshot.
  tabula check-rls       Check row-level security settings on tables.
  tabula check-login-role Verify login role hygiene (NOINHERIT, memberships, grants, ownership, CREATE).
  tabula inventory       Collect SQL call sites and their role assignments from Go source.
  tabula verify-roles    Prepare and explain each role's workload.
  tabula grants          Compare direct grants with a manifest and report reconciliation SQL.
  tabula minimize        Trial grant removals in a rolled-back transaction.
  tabula catalog         Snapshot the PostgreSQL authorization catalog or compare saved snapshots.
  tabula check-policies  Classify installed policies using application rules.
  tabula check-coverage  Check RLS command coverage for a role workload.
  tabula test-rls        Run a role and scope matrix against expected rows or denials.
Use tabula <command> -h for flags.
```

### tabula check

```text
Usage of check:
  -dsn string
        PostgreSQL DSN (defaults to TABULA_DSN)
  -role string
        optional PostgreSQL role to SET LOCAL ROLE before PREPARE/EXPLAIN
  -snapshot string
        path to a sqlcheck snapshot file
```

### tabula check-rls

```text
Usage of check-rls:
  -dsn string
        PostgreSQL DSN (defaults to TABULA_DSN)
  -forbid-roles string
        comma-separated role names forbidden from appearing directly in policies
  -force
        require FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY (default true)
  -restrictive
        require at least one RESTRICTIVE policy per table
  -schema string
        PostgreSQL schema to audit (default "public")
  -tables string
        comma-separated table names that must have RLS enabled (default: all RLS tables in schema)
```

### tabula check-login-role

```text
Usage of check-login-role:

  -member-of string
        comma-separated exact role memberships allowed for the login role
  -role string
        PostgreSQL login role name to audit (required)
  -schemas string
        comma-separated schemas where CREATE must be denied (default "public")
```
